## Application Title Bar
- **Application Name**: GNU Image Manipulation Program
- **Window Title**: `[Vanessa] (imported)-2.0 (RGB color 8-bit gamma integer, GIMP built-in sRGB, 1 layer) 1024x1024 - GIMP`

  - Time: 18:59
  - Notification bell icon
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons on the top-right

## Desktop Environment
- **Left Dock**: Vertical application launcher with icons for:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code

  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress

- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, Select, View, Image, Layer, Colors, Tools, Filters, Windows, Help

- **Tool Icons**: 
  - Move Tool

  - Eraser Tool
  - Text Tool
  - Zoom Tool
  - Paintbrush Tool
  - Pencil Tool
  - Airbrush Tool
  - Bucket Fill Tool
  - Gradient Tool
  - Path Tool
  - Selection Tool
  - Crop Tool
  - Hand Tool
  - Zoom Tool
- **Current Tool**: Crop Tool (selected, highlighted)
- **Tool Options Panel (Crop Tool)**:
  - **Crop Options**:
    - Current layer only: unchecked
    - Delete cropped pixels: unchecked
    - Allow growing: unchecked
    - Expand from center: unchecked
    - Fixed: checked
    - Aspect ratio: dropdown set to 1024:10
    - Position: X=0, Y=0 (px)
    - Size: Width=0, Height=0 (px)
  - **Highlight Settings**:
    - Highlight opacity: 50.0
  - **Guides**:
    - No guides: selected
  - **Auto Shrink**: unchecked
  - **Shrink merged**: unchecked

## Canvas Area
- **Image Display**:
  - Image of a woman with glasses, brown hair, and a blurred green background
  - Image is selected with a yellow dashed border
  - Image dimensions: 1024x1024 pixels
  - Image file name: Vanessa.jpeg
  - Image file size: 9.8 MB
  - Image format: JPEG
  - Image mode: RGB color 8-bit gamma integer
  - Color profile: GIMP built-in sRGB
  - Layers: 1 layer
- **Image Watermark**:
  - Text at bottom right: "StyleGAN2 (Karras et al.)"

## Right Panel (Tool Options and Layers)
- **Brushes Panel**:
  - **Brush Name**: 2. Hardness 050 (51 x 51)
  - **Brush Preview**: Grid of brush shapes including stars, circles, and textured brushes
  - **Brush Settings**:
    - Basic: selected
    - Spacing: 10.0
- **Layer Panel**:
  - **Layer Options**:
    - Mode: Normal
    - Opacity: 100.0%
  - **Layer List**:
    - Single layer named "Vanessa.jpeg" with thumbnail preview
    - Layer visibility icon (eye icon) is active
- **Layer Lock Options**:
  - Lock: None selected (default)

## Status Bar (Bottom)
- **Zoom Level**: 66.7%
- **Unit**: px (pixels)
- **File Information**: Vanessa.jpeg (9.8 MB)
- **Navigation Controls**:
  - Zoom In
  - Zoom Out
  - Fit to Screen
  - Full Screen
  - Rotate Canvas
  - Flip Canvas
  - Undo
  - Redo

## Additional UI Elements
- **Image Thumbnails**:
  - Two small thumbnails at top of canvas area
  - Left thumbnail: Portrait of a woman with glasses
  - Right thumbnail: Same image, but with a different appearance
  - Close button (X) next to thumbnails
- **Ruler**:
  - Horizontal ruler at top of canvas
  - Vertical ruler on left side of canvas
  - Ruler units: pixels
- **Grid**:
  - Grid lines visible on canvas
  - Grid spacing: 100 pixels
